assumptions: GO: a set is a term's direct annotations in the GO Consortium file whose metadata names the organism's NCBI taxon; annotations are not propagated to ancestor terms.
Reactome: a set is the submitted genes Reactome maps into one pathway, inferred pathways included.
limits: GO covers the organisms the GO Consortium publishes an annotation file for; others are annotated by UniProt accession in QuickGO.
Reactome's sets hold only the submitted genes, so an over-representation background of every annotated gene becomes the annotated genes among those submitted.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which gene sets do GO or Reactome define for this organism right now?

description: Gene sets for an organism, fetched from the authority at run time instead of a bundled list: Gene Ontology terms from the GO Consortium's own annotation file for the organism (each term's direct annotations, NOT annotations dropped, term names from QuickGO), or Reactome pathways from Reactome's AnalysisService (each pathway's members among the genes you submit, in the species Reactome resolves). Returns GMT text for gene_set_overrepresentation, gene_set_enrichment and gene_set_camera, with the source, release and retrieval date.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

authority.description: go: every GO term with a direct annotation in the organism. reactome: Reactome's pathways, restricted to the genes in `genes`. Values: go (GO · GO Consortium), reactome (Reactome · AnalysisService).

genes.description: reactome: the genes to map, one per line (a 'gene value' line keeps its first field), e.g. a DE run's tested genes, in an ID system Reactome reads (Ensembl, UniProt, NCBI Gene, a model organism's own). Only applies when authority is reactome.

organism.description: the organism: an NCBI taxon ID (7227) or a name (Drosophila melanogaster, human); GO resolves it through NCBI Taxonomy, Reactome resolves it itself.

name: resolve_gene_sets

geneSets.description: the sets as GMT text: ID, name, member genes

provenance.description: the authority, the organism it resolved, its release, the retrieval date, every URL read and what the sets are restricted to
